title: Grilled hake and avo salad
steps: Pat the hake dry and rub it with a little of the oil, crushed garlic, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Grill it under a hot oven grill or in a hot non-stick pan for 3 to 4 minutes a side, until the flesh is white all the way through and flakes easily with a fork.
Slice the tomato, cucumber and avo.
Toss the spinach, tomato and cucumber with the rest of the oil and a squeeze of lemon.
Top the salad with the fish in large flakes and the avo.
